recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR-32060 follow-up is needed in core unless Pharmacy reopens the broader MedicationStatement status/adherence model; future work should start from the later FHIR-39271 and FHIR-32858 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-32060 was a Published Pharmacy change request with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested removing unknown from MedicationUsage.status, renaming completed to recorded, adding draft for implementation feedback, and adding a note that these statuses differ from prior MedicationStatement statuses.
initial_application: Historical commit 6cdd7b792e2241b7191584bd35915d4b0f9841f8, whose message mentions FHIR32060 without the hyphen, changed the then-active MedicationUsage status CodeSystem, examples, and StructureDefinition from completed/unknown to recorded/draft and added the transition note. Later FHIR-38682 rename-back commits restored MedicationStatement as the active resource while preserving that status model.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists MedicationStatement as an active resource. The current MedicationStatement StructureDefinition, status CodeSystem, and status ValueSet use recorded, entered-in-error, and draft with no completed or unknown status codes. FHIR-39271 later confirmed that status is about recording the statement and adherence carries taking/not-taking meaning; it is already represented on the combined branch by d5e940beb286ab92d70095420b10a3ad7a643d06, which fixed residual rename-era wording. FHIR-32858 is also already represented and supports the same status/adherence interpretation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already satisfies the seed request after the historical application and later FHIR-39271 cleanup.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while keeping the FHIR-32060 status redesign.
Confirmed status is record-status and adherence carries taking/not-taking semantics; already published on the combined branch as d5e940beb286ab92d70095420b10a3ad7a643d06.
Confirmed no restoration of old medication-use status codes was needed; already published on the combined branch as d23bc1561f2919b1feeaad8baae92334beb40992.
